scenarios.scenario: Repeat the active compact panel button

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the Tools ribbon is minimized to panel buttons
the user clicks the Options panel button
the temporary Options command panel appears below the button strip
the Options panel button is highlighted
the user clicks the Options panel button again
the temporary Options command panel remains visible
the Options panel button remains highlighted
the user opens the ribbon display-mode menu
the menu shows "Minimize to Panel Buttons" as selected
the temporary Options command panel remains visible
the user selects "Minimize to Tabs"
the temporary Options command panel closes
the ribbon displays tabs without a permanent panel-button strip

scenarios.scenario: Dismiss a compact panel using the selected tab

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the Tools ribbon is minimized to panel buttons
the user clicks the Options panel button
the temporary Options command panel appears below the button strip
the user clicks the selected Tools tab
the temporary Options command panel closes
the Tools panel buttons remain visible

scenarios.scenario: Dismiss a compact panel using its lower title

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the Tools ribbon is minimized to panel buttons
the user clicks the Options panel button
the temporary Options command panel appears below the button strip
the user clicks the Options title at the bottom of that panel
the temporary Options command panel closes
the Tools panel buttons remain visible

scenarios.scenario: Change ribbon context while editing an existing sketch

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part containing an existing extrusion and sketch is active in the MCAD Software
the ribbon is minimized to tabs with Tools selected
the user expands the extrusion in the model browser
the user double-clicks its sketch
the Sketch tab is selected while the ribbon remains minimized to tabs
the user selects the Tools tab
temporary Tools command groups appear beneath the tabs
Finish is available in an Exit group
the user selects Finish
sketch editing ends and the part model is displayed
the ribbon remains minimized to tabs with Tools selected

scenarios.scenario: Finish a sketch from a tabs-only ribbon

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/planar-sketch-empty-xy.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited in the MCAD Software
an existing sketch is being edited in the MCAD Software
the Sketch ribbon is minimized to tabs
the user clicks the Sketch tab
the Sketch command groups appear temporarily beneath the tabs
the temporary ribbon includes the Finish action
the user selects Finish
sketch editing ends and the part model is displayed
the ribbon remains minimized to tabs

scenarios.scenario: Switch ribbon tabs with a command panel open

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the full Tools ribbon is visible
the user selects Measure
the Measure panel opens over the workspace
the user selects the View tab
the View ribbon command groups are displayed
the Measure panel remains open
the user selects Done in the Measure panel
the Measure panel closes
the View ribbon remains visible

scenarios.scenario: Switch between an open part and the Home workspace

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the full Tools ribbon is displayed
the Home workspace is available as a document tab
the user selects the Home document tab
the Home workspace is displayed
the full Tools ribbon remains displayed with Home-context commands
Document Settings is unavailable
the user selects the open part document tab
the part workspace and its model browser are displayed
the full Tools ribbon is displayed with part-context commands
Document Settings is available
